topic: Unlocking Planar Graphs: Euler's Characteristic and Duality

sections.title: Prerequisite: Defining the Planar Graph
lecture_lines: A planar graph has no crossing edges.
animations: Show graph G with vertices and edges in #FFFFFF. Label as G. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/spider.svg]
Highlight vertices of G in #FF0000. Label them as V.
Highlight edges of G in #00FF00. Label them as E.
Highlight faces of G in #00FF00. Label them as F.
Draw a closed curve around G to denote planar embedding. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/spider.svg]

sections.title: Euler’s Characteristic Formula
lecture_lines: Connected planar graphs follow this rule.
Face F includes the infinite outer region.
animations: Display formula V - E + F = 2 in #FFFF00 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/triangle.svg] as a visual reference for vertices.
Flash V in #FF0000 to correspond with Euler's V.
Flash E in #00FF00 to correspond with Euler's E.
Flash F in #0000FF to correspond with Euler's F.
Encircle the whole formula to emphasize its significance.

sections.title: Concept of Dual Graphs
lecture_lines: Dual graph transformation: Place vertices in faces.
Connect vertices if faces share an edge.
Analogy: Sensors in rooms connect through doors.
animations: Place a point in each face of G in #FFA500 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sensor.svg].
Connect points in adjacent faces with edges in #FFFF00 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/door.svg].

sections.title: The Duality Connection
lecture_lines: Original G's faces become Dual G*'s vertices.
Original G's vertices become Dual G*'s faces.
animations: Show G and Dual G* overlapping in contrasting colors #FFFFFF and #FFA500 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Show V = F* and F = V* as text labels in #00FFFF.
Highlight the correspondence between E and E* with a dashed line [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Euler's formula defines planar graph DNA.
Duality acts as a powerful mirror tool.
animations: Display V - E + F = 2 clearly alongside the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/polyhedron.svg].
Fade out all elements to black with the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/polyhedron.svg] disappearing last.
